text.controller.ts: Runs the Check for Updates item and shows its result, and answers the window's requests for the update notice and its buttons, accepting only the four known actions.
text.controller.ts gotcha: Only a release page of the fixed repository is ever opened from a result dialog.
text.dialogs.ts: Words the result of a manual update check and the confirmation that names what a restart would end.
text.feed.ts: Reads the update service's answer for a Mac (204 up to date, 200 an update, 404 no download for this build) and GitHub's latest release for other platforms, with a timeout and no token.
text.feed.ts gotcha: The release page link is built from the tag on the fixed repository, never taken from the answer.
text.feed.ts = ext:electron-update-service: asks for the newest build for this platform and version
text.feed.ts = ext:github-api: asks for the latest release without a token
text.guard.ts: Decides whether an update may install now: false while a run started by Lantern, an editor terminal or an editor process is alive, or when that cannot be read; sessions in other terminals do not count.
text.native.ts: Adapts Electron's Squirrel updater to a small interface: set the feed, check, install, and downloaded, none-available and error events.
text.native.ts = ext:electron-update-service: has Squirrel read the JSON feed and download the build
text.process-activity.ts: Counts the terminals and the running commands, agents, tests and servers below Lantern from the process list, so a restart's cost is known.
text.process-activity.ts gotcha: Its own process listing shows up in the list and is skipped.
text.process-activity.ts = ext:macos-process-: reads the process table with ps
text.service.ts: Checks on start and every four hours, downloads on a Mac and installs only when the guard allows and the user has not postponed it, or on a confirmed Restart now, and otherwise publishes a release notice.
text.service.ts gotcha: A failing check is logged as a warning and never shown; with the setting off nothing is requested at all.
text.version.ts: Compares semantic versions, pre-releases included, and tells whether one is newer.
